rho_definition: Common total non-exit substitution probability; conditional non-exit destination weights retain the base pattern.
eta_definition: Price_i = mean(base_price) + eta * (base_price_i - mean(base_price)); all other unit costs retain their base values.
history: Expanded after inspecting earlier 3x3 and 4x5 maps; all 36 combinations fixed before this follow-up run. It is not a new held-out validation.
training_reuse: One complete model per eta, method and seed is shared across six rho evaluations; each deployment clones online and target weights plus the last 1500 training transitions.
release_scope: Exact complete aggregated and paired-seed CSVs; historical training checkpoints, period-level archives and the historical grid reproduction runner are not bundled.
